Before you open this pull request:

1. Target `develop`.
2. Title it as a conventional commit: `feat: ...`, `fix: ...`, `refactor: ...`,
   `docs: ...`, `test: ...`, `chore: ...`. The title becomes the commit message
   when the PR is squash-merged, and feeds the release notes.
3. Run the tests and `pre-commit run --all-files` locally.
4. Keep business logic and validation on the server.
5. Put `closes #NN` in the description if it fixes an issue.
6. Use only demo or made-up data in code, tests, screenshots and this
   description. Never a real company's names, figures or documents.
-->
